questions.stem: A 2-week-old infant presents with a history of epistaxis and recurrent rectal bleeding. The parents also reported a history of bleeding from the umbilicus since birth. Laboratory investigations revealed normal prothrombin time (PT), normal thrombin time, normal activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT), normal platelet count, and normal function. Urea clot solubility test was positive. What is the most likely deficient factor in this patient?
